name: My Oppai Mommy Makes Me Want To Spill All Of My Company Secrets
source:
As the CEO of Aquifer Technologies, you have a lot of weight on your shoulders, taking important decisions all day. Good thing you have your trusty aide by your side: the tall, busty, statuesque and motherly Elizabeth Fields.

If only she would stop treating you like a little boy in front of the entire office.

One day, after a critical cybersecurity update at the company, Elizabeth makes a move on you and invites you out to dinner. What are her true intentions? And if things go south with Elizabeth, will you be able to resist her maternal charms, or will you end up calling her 'Mommy' and tell her all of the company secrets?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
身为Aquifer Technologies的首席执行官，你每天都要作出重大决策，肩上担子不轻。好在身边有值得信赖的助手伊丽莎白·菲尔兹。她身材高挑，胸部丰满，亭亭玉立，还特别会照顾人。

要是她肯别当着整个办公室的面把你当个小男孩哄就好了。

一天，公司刚完成一项关键的网络安全更新，伊丽莎白便主动向你示好，约你出去吃晚饭。她到底打的是什么主意？要是和伊丽莎白的事出了岔子，你能抵挡她那一身母性的魅力吗？还是会喊着“妈妈”，把公司机密全都告诉她？

［取自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664690/]Steam[/url]］
